changes: Keep the traffic headlight list constant; use zero intensity for off-map cars, preserving positions and night brightness.
Use one WebGL pacing deadline instead of an additional minimum-interval gate that rounded 24 Hz to 20 Hz on 60 Hz displays.
Use non-blocking GPU elapsed-time queries after the frame fence, when supported, so delayed RAF callbacks do not inflate the cooldown.
Extend opt-in diagnostics with GPU timing, frame-time percentiles and program count.

checks.headlight regression: Stable visible light count across eight combinations of car visibility; zero light from hidden traffic; original moving positions retained.
checks.timer regression: No blocking reads of unavailable queries; disjoint/unsupported results fall back to existing conservative timing.
checks.browser: Night map visually inspected in portfolio and standalone preview.

measurementLimit: Before-run logs are saved. Later preview callbacks were throttled to approximately 1 Hz despite document visibility being visible. The after logs are explicitly labelled throttled, and do not support a before/after FPS claim.
rejectedExperiment: Per-fragment light-range branching increased shader compilation cost; removed entirely.
